annotations.title: Net salary: United Kingdom vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in United Kingdom (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

child_benefit.description: Claim Child Benefit. With children: Child Benefit is shown, and above £60,000 the charge that claws it back. Default true.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many GBP, for the euro amounts. Default 0.84 (indicative).

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in United Kingdom, in GBP

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

pension_method.description: How pension is paid. Salary sacrifice saves tax and NI; net pay saves tax; relief at source is paid from net pay and HMRC adds 25%.: sacrifice = Salary sacrifice; netpay = Net pay arrangement; ras = Relief at source. Default sacrifice.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

region.description: Where you live: ruk = England, Wales or Northern Ireland; scotland = Scotland. Default ruk.

student_loan.description: Student loan: none = None; plan1 = Plan 1; plan2 = Plan 2; plan4 = Plan 4 (Scotland); plan5 = Plan 5. Default none.

name: compare_with_netherlands
title: Net salary: United Kingdom vs the Netherlands
